description: Lightweight contract for read-only platform reports generated from registries and tracked compact artifacts.
security_rules: Report generation is read-only with respect to canonical tracked artifacts.
Raw data, local-only analysis tables, row-level predictions, and serialized models must not be read.
Credentials, absolute paths, usernames, home directories, and local host metadata must not be stored.
Report outputs are local-only and must be written under outputs/platform_reports.
Registry diagnostics are opt-in and read persisted metadata only; report generation must not run diagnose-run automatically.
PGIR governance summaries are optional and read compact registries/code metadata only; they must not run physics execution, API acquisition, model training, or raw artifact reads.
PGIR conformance and Battery PGIR summaries are optional read-only summaries over compact tracked artifacts; row-level battery observations, operational states, and trajectories remain local-only.
Battery mechanism audit summaries are optional read-only summaries over compact v2.3.3 artifacts; they must not execute parameter fitting, solvers, predictive models, or hidden-state inference.
Battery capacity evaluator summaries are optional read-only summaries over compact v2.3.4 aggregates; they must not load trajectory bodies or row-level findings during report generation.
External source and second-domain PGIR reuse sections read tracked compact summaries only; they must not call APIs, load raw structures or graph bodies, regenerate features, or execute models.
